pokedexEntries.bk: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.

pokedexEntries.wh: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

pokedexEntries.sw: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.
